title: Check request fields
responsibility: Checks basic request objects, text, identifiers, choices and normalized image regions.

inputs.name: ipcFields.value
inputs.description: The request object to check, which must be non-null and not an array; null, undefined, other primitives, functions and arrays fail with 'Expected an object.' and any other object, including a class instance, is returned unchanged.
inputs.unknownReason: IPC data can be any runtime value before the object shape check.

inputs.name: textField.value
inputs.description: The candidate text, which must be a string that is not blank after trimming and no longer than max; any value that fails these checks throws 'Invalid text field.'
inputs.unknownReason: The candidate IPC field must be narrowed to a string before its length and contents can be checked.

inputs.name: textField.max
inputs.description: The largest allowed string length, compared with the string's length property (UTF-16 code units); a longer string throws 'Invalid text field.' Defaults to 300 when omitted.

inputs.name: textField.pattern
inputs.description: An optional RegExp that the text must match, checked with pattern.test(value); a non-matching text throws 'Invalid identifier.' When omitted, no pattern check runs.

inputs.name: nullableText.value
inputs.description: Either null, which is returned as null, or a string that is not blank after trimming and is at most 300 characters long. Undefined is not null, so it throws 'Invalid text field.' like any other non-string value.
inputs.unknownReason: The IPC field may be any value before the explicit null branch or text validation.

inputs.name: nullableText.pattern
inputs.description: An optional RegExp that a non-null text must match, checked with pattern.test(value) inside textField; a non-matching text throws 'Invalid identifier.' Null is returned as null without any pattern check.

inputs.name: enumField.value
inputs.description: The candidate choice, which is accepted only when it equals one entry of allowed as checked by Array.prototype.includes; any other value throws 'Invalid option.'
inputs.unknownReason: The raw candidate is narrowed by matching one of the supplied enum options.

inputs.name: enumField.allowed
inputs.description: The complete list of permitted values, searched with Array.prototype.includes, so the order of entries does not matter and an empty list rejects every value. Entries are compared as given, with no trimming or case folding.

inputs.name: regionField.value
inputs.description: Either null, which returns null, or an object whose x, y, width and height are finite numbers from 0 to 1 with positive width and height, and whose x + width and y + height do not exceed 1.000001 (a 0.000001 edge tolerance). A value that is neither null nor a non-array object throws 'Expected an object.', coordinates that are not finite numbers from 0 to 1 throw 'Invalid image region.', and rectangles with zero width or height or that extend past the image throw 'Image region is outside the image.'
inputs.unknownReason: The raw input may be null or require validation as an image-region object.

outputs.name: ipcFields
outputs.description: The same object reference that was passed in, with its keys and values left unchanged rather than filtered or copied.

outputs.name: textField
outputs.description: The exact accepted string, returned without trimming, so any leading or trailing whitespace is kept.

outputs.name: nullableText
outputs.description: Null when the input is null, otherwise the same accepted string that textField returns without trimming.

outputs.name: hashPattern
outputs.description: A RegExp, /^[a-f0-9]{64}$/, that accepts exactly 64 lowercase hexadecimal characters and nothing else.

outputs.name: commitPattern
outputs.description: A RegExp, /^[a-f0-9]{40}$/, that accepts exactly 40 lowercase hexadecimal characters and nothing else.

outputs.name: idPattern
outputs.description: A RegExp, /^[a-z0-9]+(?:[.-][a-z0-9]+)*$/, that accepts lowercase letter-or-digit segments separated by single dots or hyphens, such as reports.component.evidence-grid. It rejects uppercase letters, leading or trailing separators and doubled separators.

outputs.name: versionPattern
outputs.description: A RegExp that accepts a lowercase v followed by three or more decimal digits and nothing else, such as v001.

outputs.name: enumField
outputs.description: The supplied value, returned unchanged and only after it equals one of the allowed entries.

outputs.name: regionField
outputs.description: Null for null input, otherwise a new object that contains only x, y, width and height copied from the checked rectangle.

errors.name: IpcFieldError
errors.description: Thrown as an IpcFieldError whose message identifies the failed check: 'Expected an object.' (ipcFields and regionField), 'Invalid text field.' or 'Invalid identifier.' (textField and nullableText), or 'Invalid option.' (enumField).

errors.name: ImageRegionError
errors.description: Thrown as an ImageRegionError by regionField: 'Invalid image region.' for coordinates that are not finite numbers from 0 to 1, and 'Image region is outside the image.' for zero width or height or a rectangle that extends past the image.
